Configuration for Git to handle text files and set line endings for shell scripts.

# Purpose
The configuration file specifies text file handling rules for a version control system. The `* text=auto` line ensures that all text files are automatically normalized to the system's native line endings. The `*.sh text eol=lf` line enforces that shell script files (`.sh`) use LF (Line Feed) as the line ending, regardless of the operating system.
